registration: Post-hoc supplement: native results were already observed; fixed before these new runs.

training.paired: Within each seed: identical initial parameters, full data order, optimizer, objective, 48-interval training horizon and final checkpoint; integration only differs.
training.euler: One step per 1/30 s frame interval
training.rk4: Four classical RK4 substeps per 1/30 s frame interval
training.inference: Common native adaptive Dopri5, rtol 1e-7 atol 1e-9; no future truth; same prefix and time grid as parent.
training.scope: Privileged-state controls. Native Dopri5 remains an additional reference. Not equal-budget cross-model training.

metrics: four-step window-reset latent forecast and latent persistence
video_diagnosis.separation: Reconstruction and reset windows observe later images and are diagnostic only; future forecast encodes only the first three images.

physics.raw: Preserve geometry-gated raw force/energy nulls and all denominators.
physics.additional_readout: Use predicted B position, velocity and acceleration to decode crank angle/rate/acceleration; reconstruct exact closure from known geometry and analytic derivatives. Apply the same additional readout to both models and all arms.
physics.label: Geometry-conditioned crank readout intervention, separate from raw native results; correction magnitude and point error must be reported.
physics.calibration: 54 withheld calibration trajectories, original thresholds, oracle/persistence/timewarp checks; no fitting on calibration or test.
physics.withheld: No future reference state, actual torque, mass, inertia or friction enters either predictor or geometric readout.

failure_policy: Retain incomplete and nonfinite cases with their original denominators.
